en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large corner hotel building in a European spa town. The four‑story structure has ornate late 19th‑century facades with many windows, balconies, and decorative cornices. Several well‑dressed people stand on the sidewalk in front. The main sign on the building reads "HOTEL STERN." At the top left, printed text says "Marienbad. Hôtel Stern." and along the right margin there is vertical printing giving the publisher information.
